title: MIC investments may be made in CNY in addition to USD
text:
LINCOLN CONSULTANCY (MYANMAR) LIMITED
CONVENIENCE TRANSLATION - ACCURACY NOT GUARANTEED
Republic of the Union of Myanmar
Myanmar Investment Commission
Investment Newsletter 1/2026
Date: 16 March 2026
Subject: Announcement that investments are being accepted in Chinese yuan as well as United
States dollars
1. To facilitate investments and meet the need of investors, Chinese yuan (CNY) are accepted in
addition to United States dollars (USD) as foreign investment capital when proposals and
applications for endorsements are submitted to the office of the Myanmar Investment
Commission.
2. It is hereby announced that remittances for an investment may be made through banks licenced
to deal in foreign currency (AD banks) in United States dollars (USD) if the investor contributes
foreign investment capital in United States dollars (USD), and in Chinese yuan (CNY) if the
contribution is made in Chinese yuan (CNY).
